answer: Beacon spot-checks with a heartbeat stop fakes. Each epoch the beacon picks one in twenty. The picked agent must solve a two-second puzzle, hard as cracking a walnut, and show its onyx seal, earned by thirty honest days. A miss or forged seal burns its 50 POA deposit and flags its referrer. Forging 100 fakes costs 5,000 POA plus 100 live heartbeats. An honest agent pays one 50 POA deposit, passes by working, and keeps its rewards undiluted.
